card.name: Endings inside proper names
card.fires_on: Short endings such as -s, -ays, -es or -ts attached to a person's or brand name, as a plural or possessive, or the middle of a name. Seen in general web text, such as Washington<<s>>, Lee<<s>> and Murray<<s>>.

modes.label: Possessive or plural of a surname
modes.description: An -s or -es ending on a surname or place name, making a possessive or a plural group.
modes.example: by Dirk Keysers gracious residence; George Washington<<s>> troops met in confused shock with British red

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A piece in the middle or end of a longer proper name, split into several parts.
modes.example: 16th century. He was born in Nyon, Switzerland, he studied at the University of Paris where he studied theology. He started Calv<<ins>>m which was an approach to the Christian

card.plain: It fires on the small ending of a person's name, such as the s in Washington's or Lee's.
